name: Raw Red Radishes (Insoluble Roughage & Pungency Warning)
whyItWorks: Raw radishes have dense, crunchy cell walls that resist mastication and contain sharp isothiocyanates. The chemical pungency irritates gastric mucosa while the unyielding chunks scrape inflamed intestinal lining.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid raw sliced radishes on salads. If craving radishes in remission, roast them whole in olive oil until soft and sweet like baby turnips.
watchOuts: Sharp mustard-oil compounds and hard texture provoke stomach irritation and colonic spasms.
